		<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // === 1. Custom ALT text per carousel-item ===
    const customCarouselAltTexts = {
      0: "'Stop Ebola' escrito en inglés en la pizarra de un aula.",
      1: "Un hombre sonriendo.",
      2: "Una chica con dolor de cabeza que se sujeta la cabeza."
    };

    // === 2. Custom ALT text for health-topics section ===
    const customHealthTopicsAltText = "Un salón de clases vacío con un tablero en que está escrito en inglés “Detenga al Ébola” y una descripción de los signos y síntomas.";

    // Handle carousel images
    const carouselItems = document.querySelectorAll("#hero-carousel .carousel-inner .carousel-item");

    carouselItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const img = item.querySelector("img");
      if (!img) return;

      const customAlt = item.dataset.alt || customCarouselAltTexts[index];
      if (customAlt) {
        img.alt = customAlt;
        console.log(`Carousel image ${index} alt updated: ${customAlt}`);
      }
    });

    // Handle health-topics section
    const healthSection = document.querySelector(".health-topics");
    if (healthSection) {
      const imgs = healthSection.querySelectorAll("img");
      if (imgs.length > 0) {
        const lastImg = imgs[imgs.length - 1];
        lastImg.alt = customHealthTopicsAltText;
        console.log(`Health-topics last image alt updated: ${customHealthTopicsAltText}`);
      }
    }

    // === 3. Fix escaped <em> tags in hero carousel visible text ===
    document.querySelectorAll("#hero-carousel .slide-title, #hero-carousel .indicator-text").forEach(el => {
      if (el.innerHTML.includes("<em>") || el.innerHTML.includes("</em>")) {
        el.innerHTML = el.textContent;
      }
    });

    // === 4. Clean escaped <em> from aria-labels ===
    document.querySelectorAll("#hero-carousel [aria-label]").forEach(el => {
      const label = el.getAttribute("aria-label");
      if (!label) return;

      const cleanedLabel = label
        .replace(/<\/?em>/g, "")
        .replace(/<\/?em>/g, "");

      el.setAttribute("aria-label", cleanedLabel);
    });
  });
</script>
